svgConcept.description: viewBox='0 0 952 420'. Build a horizontal authorization rail at y=228 from x=58 to x=895. A scheduled-reload clock assembly sits at x=180,y=145; an adjustable cancellation gate crosses the rail at x=400; a completed-load ratchet sits at x=638; the rail then feeds a small cylindrical cash tank at x=790–910,y=145–345. Mark the scheduled reload as T at x=638 and the deadline as T − 24 h at x=400, with an anchored dimension bracket between them. Use an open gate and a return branch before the deadline. Beyond the completed-load ratchet, show a solid forward path and a small blocked reverse arrow tied specifically to this cancellation provision—not a universal prohibition on refunds or legal remedies. The tank is schematic, with no invented monetary scale. Render 'T − 24 h', 'T' and 'COMPLETED' as short anchored SVG labels; the exact contractual wording belongs in HTML. Use 3px orange for the release rail and deadline pointer, 1.5–2px ink structure at 0.25 opacity, and clearly outlined surface fills.
